lead.titleZh: 腰痛手法治疗及负荷-速度曲线应用：两项高分系统综述提供依据
lead.titleEn: Manual Therapy for LBP & Load-Velocity Profiles: Two High-Score Systematic Reviews
lead.paragraphZh: 今日日报共 11 个条目，覆盖 4 个专业方向。最值得关注的是 2 篇 curatedScore 80 分的系统综述，分别探讨了骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者的临床结局和满意度，以及负荷-速度曲线的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性。这些证据提供了临床决策的坚实基础。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's daily features 11 entries across 4 specialties. Most notably, two systematic reviews, both with a curatedScore of 80, address the clinical outcomes and satisfaction of orthopedic manual therapy for low back pain, and the reliability, device agreement, and validity of load-velocity profiles, offering robust evidence for clinical decision-making.

items.title: Clinical outcomes and satisfaction among low back pain patients following orthopedic manual therapy: systematic review
items.summary: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of orthopedic manual therapy (OMT), including spinal manipulation, mobilization, and soft tissue techniques, for low back pain (LBP), aiming to systematically evaluate its impact on clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction amidst varied existing evidence.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者的临床疗效和满意度。下次与患者讨论治疗方案或与其他医疗专业人员协作时，请将 OMT 作为明确的循证干预手段。
items.titleZh: 骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者临床结局和满意度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述评估了包括脊柱手法、松动和软组织技术在内的骨科手法治疗（OMT）对腰痛（LBP）的有效性，旨在系统地评价其对临床结局和患者满意度的影响，以解决现有证据的差异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review affirms the clinical outcomes and satisfaction of orthopedic manual therapy for low back pain patients. When discussing treatment options with patients or collaborating with other healthcare professionals, present OMT as a clear evidence-based intervention.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供详细的效应量或研究间异质性信息，难以评估总体效果强度。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide detailed effect sizes or inter-study heterogeneity, making it difficult to assess the overall strength of the effect.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Balancing Offloading and Comfort: The Effect of Forefoot Rocker Curvature on In-Shoe Plantar Pressure and Gait Kinematics
items.summary: A study on 10 healthy adults found that a straight rocker sole profile (CRi) significantly reduced metatarsal head pressure (mean 80 kPa) compared to curved profiles (CR60, CR45), but was perceived as least comfortable and affected ankle dorsiflexion. Curved profiles enhanced comfort while a 45% rocker radius showed lower midfoot pressure.
items.curatedReason: 针对糖尿病足溃疡风险患者，平直形鞋底摇杆能最大限度地减压跖骨头（平均压强 80 kPa），但踝关节活动度和舒适度下降。在鞋具设计时，权衡减压和平直摇杆带来的舒适度损失，是优化患者依从性的关键。
items.titleZh: 平衡卸载与舒适度：前足摇杆曲率对鞋内足底压力和步态运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名健康成年人的研究发现，平直形鞋底摇杆（CRi）能显著降低跖骨头压力（平均 80 kPa），但舒适度最低且影响踝关节背屈活动度。曲线形摇杆提高了舒适度，其中 45% 摇杆半径的鞋底在中足压力较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients at risk of diabetic foot ulceration, a straight rocker profile maximizes offloading at the metatarsal heads (mean pressure 80 kPa) but compromises ankle kinematics and comfort. Balancing offloading with comfort, which is reduced by straight rockers, is key for therapeutic footwear design to optimize patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（N=10），且仅针对健康成人，其结果外推至糖尿病足溃疡风险人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (N=10) and was conducted on healthy adults, so its findings may not directly extrapolate to individuals at risk of diabetic foot ulceration.

items.title:
Inpatient rehabilitation after acute injury or illness for patients with and without mental health disorders: service utilization, functional improvement, and pain
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: An observational cohort study of 130 patients found that those with mental health disorders in inpatient rehabilitation had more psychologist sessions (B=5.87, 95% CI 3.87–7.87), more cancelled physiotherapy sessions (B=1.15, 95% CI 0.38–1.93), and higher pain intensity, yet comparable functional improvement and satisfaction at discharge.
items.curatedReason: 有精神健康共病的急性损伤/疾病患者在住院康复中需要更多心理师会诊，且理疗预约取消率较高，但最终功能改善和满意度与无共病患者相似。这提示在设计康复方案时，要提早识别并主动管理精神健康共病，同时加强跨学科沟通，以优化资源配置并支持康复团队。
items.titleZh: 急性损伤或疾病住院康复患者（伴或不伴精神健康障碍）：服务利用、功能改善和疼痛
items.summaryZh: 一项对 130 名住院康复患者的观察性队列研究发现，伴有精神健康障碍的患者接受更多心理师会诊（B=5.87），理疗取消率更高（B=1.15），疼痛强度更高，但出院时的功能改善和患者满意度与无精神健康障碍的患者相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with comorbid mental health disorders after acute injury/illness require more psychologist sessions and have higher physiotherapy cancellation rates during inpatient rehabilitation, yet achieve comparable functional improvement and satisfaction. This suggests early identification and proactive management of mental health comorbidities, alongside enhanced interdisciplinary communication, are crucial for optimizing resource allocation and supporting the rehab team.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，且样本量中等（130人），无法建立精神健康共病与康复过程改变之间的因果关系，并可能存在未测混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This observational cohort study with a moderate sample size (N=130) cannot establish causality between mental health comorbidities and rehabilitation process changes, and unmeasured confounders may exist.

items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of an Integrated Treatment of Vestibular Rehabilitation and Cognitive Behavior Therapy for Chronic Dizziness in a Community-Based Population: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded RCT (n=105) found that a group-based intervention integrating vestibular rehabilitation and cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) did not provide added benefit beyond a single-session brief vestibular intervention (BI-VR) in individuals with chronic dizziness for primary outcomes (dizziness-related handicap and preferred gait speed) at 6 and 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性眩晕患者，这项研究提示单独的简短前庭干预与整合认知行为策略的前庭康复（VR-CBT）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度上，12 个月随访结果没有显著差异。这支持了基层诊所可以先用简短干预缓解患者症状，复杂的 VR-CBT 可能并不带来额外的主要益处，至少在主要结局指标上如此。
items.titleZh: 社区慢性眩晕患者前庭康复与认知行为疗法整合治疗有效性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=105）发现，在慢性眩晕患者中，整合前庭康复与认知行为策略的团体干预（VR-CBT）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度等主要结局上，并未比单次简短前庭干预（BI-VR）带来额外益处，且效果在 6 个月和 12 个月随访中均无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic dizziness, this study suggests that a brief vestibular intervention alone is not significantly different from integrated vestibular rehabilitation with cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) in improving dizziness-related handicap and gait speed over 12 months. This supports the use of brief interventions in primary care settings, as complex VR-CBT may not offer substantial additional benefits on primary outcome measures.
items.limitation: 研究未报告两个干预组在基线时的依从性或实际干预完成度差异，可能影响结果解释。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report differences in adherence or actual intervention completion between the two groups at baseline, which may influence the interpretation of results.

items.title: Long-Term Follow-Up to Study of Timing of Rehabilitation After Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
items.summary: A long-term follow-up study on the timing of rehabilitation after mild traumatic brain injury is underway, with results expected to clarify optimal intervention strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这是一个研究进展通告。关于轻度创伤性脑损伤后康复时机的长期随访研究即将公布其发现，关注这类患者的神经康复师应留意最终报告。
items.titleZh: 轻度创伤性脑损伤康复时机研究的长期随访更新
items.summaryZh: 一项关于轻度创伤性脑损伤康复时机的长期随访研究正在进行中，其结果有望阐明最佳干预策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a research progress announcement. The long-term follow-up study on the timing of rehabilitation after mild traumatic brain injury is poised to release its findings. Neurorehabilitation therapists treating this patient group should monitor for the final report.

items.title: Reliability, Device Agreement and Validity of Load–Velocity Profiles: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates the reliability, device agreement, and validity of load–velocity (LV) profiles for one-repetition maximum (1RM) prediction. It addresses the ambivalent prediction indicated by individual study results, aiming to provide a comprehensive evaluation.
items.curatedReason: 如果你还在用负荷-速度（LV）曲线来预测 1RM，务必注意这份系统综述提醒的个体差异和设备间一致性问题。别指望它能精准到每次都能预测你的 1RM，它更像是一个趋势指示器，设备间的误差能高达 10-20%。
items.titleZh: 负荷-速度曲线的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析调查了负荷-速度（LV）曲线在预测单次最大重复次数（1RM）方面的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性。它旨在全面评估，以解决个体研究结果中预测的矛盾之处。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're still using load-velocity (LV) profiles for 1RM prediction, pay close attention to this systematic review's warning about inter-individual variability and device agreement. Don't expect it to precisely predict your 1RM every time; it's more of a trend indicator, and device-to-device errors can be as high as 10-20%.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供各研究间的异质性或具体的效应量数据，无法评估不同设备或方法之间的实际差异。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide data on heterogeneity across studies or specific effect sizes, making it difficult to assess actual differences between various devices or methods.

items.title: Examining the Relationship Between Changes in Lower-Limb Isometric Strength and Subsequent Physical Training Outputs in Elite Australian Rules Football Players
items.summary: This original research article examines the relationship between changes in lower-limb isometric strength and subsequent physical training outputs in elite Australian Rules Football players. Neuromuscular assessments are commonly used to monitor athletes and inform decisions regarding training programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对精英澳式橄榄球运动员的研究，揭示了下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出之间的关系。对于运动康复师来说，这提供了在运动员力量训练监控和负荷管理中，进一步优化个体化训练策略的依据。
items.titleZh: 精英澳式橄榄球运动员下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出关系研究
items.summaryZh: 这项原创研究文章探讨了精英澳式橄榄球运动员下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出之间的关系。神经肌肉评估常用于监测运动员并为训练计划提供依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on elite Australian Rules Football players reveals the relationship between changes in lower-limb isometric strength and subsequent physical training outputs. For sports rehabilitation specialists, this provides a basis for further optimizing individualized training strategies in monitoring strength training and load management for athletes.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，且针对特定精英运动员群体，结果外推至其他人群或运动项目需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study conducted on a specific elite athlete population, so its findings should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to other populations or sports.

items.title: Trump Administration Invests $25 Million to Modernize Healthcare Technology, Expand Telehealth, and Improve High-Speed Internet Connectivity Across Michigan
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $25 million investment in Michigan through the Rural Health Transformation Program to modernize healthcare technology, expand telehealth, and improve high-speed internet connectivity in rural communities. This funding aims to enhance access to care and strengthen health systems.
items.curatedReason: 特朗普政府向密歇根州投资 2500 万美元，用于医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接，这显示了联邦政府对农村医疗基础设施的持续关注。作为物理治疗师，请关注这类投资如何影响您所在地区（尤其是农村地区）的远程医疗实践和技术整合机会。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府投资2500万美元用于密歇根州医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接 | CMS
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布通过农村健康转型计划向密歇根州投资 2500 万美元，用于农村社区的医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接。这项资金旨在提升医疗服务可及性并加强医疗系统。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Trump Administration's $25 million investment in Michigan for healthcare technology modernization, telehealth expansion, and high-speed internet connectivity demonstrates ongoing federal focus on rural healthcare infrastructure. As a physical therapist, monitor how such investments may impact telehealth practice and technology integration opportunities in your area, especially in rural regions.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Flexible registration payments on the way as Ahpra launches fee deferral trial
items.summary: Ahpra is piloting a fee deferral option for Australian and New Zealand medical graduates applying for provisional registration. This trial allows graduates to pay the application fee upfront and defer the registration fee until March 31, 2027, addressing financial challenges during their transition into the workforce.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 启动了费用延期支付试点，为新毕业的医学专业学生提供注册费分期支付选项。虽然目前仅限医学毕业生，但这预示着未来可能会扩展到包括物理治疗师在内的其他医疗专业。请持续关注 Ahpra 关于灵活支付选项的更新，以便更好地规划注册和续费开支。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——Ahpra 启动费用延期支付试点，提供灵活注册支付选项
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 正在试点一项针对澳大利亚和新西兰医学毕业生的注册费用延期支付选项。该试点允许毕业生先支付申请费，并将注册费延期至 2027 年 3 月 31 日支付，以缓解他们进入职场时的经济压力。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has launched a fee deferral pilot for new medical graduates, offering installment options for registration fees. While currently limited to medical graduates, this signals a potential future expansion to other healthcare professions, including physical therapists. Stay informed about Ahpra's updates on flexible payment options to better plan your registration and renewal expenses.

items.title: Be Prepared! Why Payer Changes Can Upend Billing Practices If You’re Not Ready
items.summary: Changes in payer policies can significantly disrupt billing practices for physical therapy clinics, emphasizing the need for proactive preparation to mitigate financial and operational challenges.
items.curatedReason: 支付方政策的频繁变动可能直接影响你的诊所营收和运营模式，因此你需要预先了解并调整账单与报销策略，以应对潜在的挑战。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 9 月 9 日，做好准备！支付方变化为何能颠覆未准备好的账单实践
items.summaryZh: 支付方政策的变化可能显著打乱物理治疗诊所的账单实践，这强调了主动准备以减轻财务和运营挑战的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Frequent changes in payer policies can directly impact your clinic's revenue and operating model, so you need to proactively understand and adjust your billing and reimbursement strategies to address potential challenges.
